title: Randomized phase II trial of Cemiplimab plus OSE2101 (TEDOPI®) as maintenance  therapy in ctDNA positive NSCLC.
official: A Randomized phase II trial of Cemiplimab plus OSE2101 (TEDOPI®) as maintenance therapy in ctDNA positive NSCL. The Cemited study.
summary: Main objective: to determine ctDNA clearance in TEDOPI plus cemiplimab versus cemiplimab +\- pemetrexed (standard maintenance arm) in patients with HLA-A2 positive NSCLC not progressing after 4 cycles of chemoimmunotherapy.

interventions.name: Armisarte 25 mg/ml concentrate for solution for infusion
LIBTAYO 350 mg concentrate for solution for infusion.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of non-oncogene addicted advanced, locally advanced (not suitable for definitive chemoradiation therapy) or metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
2. Any patient candidate for first line chemoimmunotherapy irrespective of PD-L1 levels
3. HLA-A2 positive
4. ECOG PS 0-1
5. Signed informed consent (IC) prior to any trial-specific procedures.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients not candidate for chemoimmunotherapy
2. HLA-A2 negative
3. Symptomatic or not previously treated and not stable brain metastases. Brain metastases are allowed if asymptomatic or pretreated
4. Tumor tissue not available (archive or collected before trial inclusion)
5. Evidence of EGFR mutations or ALK or ROS1 rearrangements
6. Performance status >1 (ECOG)
7. Diagnosis of another cancer in the last 3 years, except for in situ carcinoma of cervix, breast and bladder or skin carcinoma (squamous or basaloid)
